user.title: Homekeeper
user.description: Shared household duties. Add people, modules and duties from the integration page afterwards.

init.title: Homekeeper options
init.description: Map condition names to sensors, one per line: name=sensor.entity_id

data.name: Name
data.person_entity: Home Assistant person (links their login to this person)

error.quiet_both: Set both quiet hours times, or neither.

schedule.title: Schedule: {type}
schedule.description: Durations look like 3d, 2w, 6m, 1y. Dates are MM-DD. Conditions look like soil_temp_5day_avg_f:50.

data.calendar: Calendar to follow (e.g. your city's trash pickup calendar)
data.match: Only events containing (comma separated, e.g. garbage; blank = every event)
data.lead: Do it this long before each event (1d = the evening before, 0d = the same day)

data_description.calendar: Add the pickup calendar first: Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > Remote Calendar, with your city's trash calendar link.
data_description.match: For a city trash calendar, use garbage: it may also list drop-off and leaf collection days. Homekeeper shows the carts from the event title on the to-do and in the push (Garbage + Recycling).
data_description.notify_at: If the duty is still open the next morning, the overdue push waits until 6:00.

data.remind: Remind relative to the due date: -3d = 3 days before, 0d = on the day (e.g. -3d,0d)
data.escalate_after: Escalate to admins when overdue by (e.g. 2d = 2 days after the due date)
data.nfc_tags: NFC tag IDs that complete this (comma separated; from Settings > Tags)

first_module.title: First, a module
first_module.description: Duties live in modules (like Bills, Lawn or Home). You don't have one yet, so make it here.

error.bad_duration: Use a number and a unit, like 3d (days), 2w (weeks) or 1m (months). Put a minus in front for before the due date, like -3d.
error.bad_months: Use month numbers from 1 to 12 separated by commas, like 3,4,5.

user.title: Biller
user.description: A sender BillBot reads. Bills open a pay duty. Income (like rent) completes the duties listed under Completes.

data.name: Name BillBot files it under (e.g. Duke Energy)
data.cadence_days: Expected days between bills (blank = don't check)
data.grace_days: Grace days before it is flagged as silent
data.completes: Income only: duty IDs completed when money arrives
data.escalate_after: Escalate to admins after overdue by (e.g. 2d)

data_description.login_url: The company's sign-in page, starting with https://. Shown on the bill's to-do and as a Log in button on the dashboard card.
data_description.login_note: Where the family finds the password, e.g. Bitwarden > Home Bills > Duke Energy. Do not type the password here: every Home Assistant user can read this.
data_description.name_ar: Shown next to the name in the bills table and used in Arabic reminders, e.g. الكهرباء.
data_description.icon: Shown in the bills table, e.g. mdi:flash for electric.

first_module.title: First, a module
first_module.description: Duties live in modules (like Bills, Lawn or Home). You don't have one yet, so make it here.

error.bad_details: Check the numbers and reminder durations.
error.bad_url: Use a full web address starting with https://

user.title: Tidy calendar
user.description: A cleaned-up copy of another calendar for your dashboard: only the days you want, each titled with what is collected (Garbage + Recycling). Nothing to check off.

data.name: Name
data.match: Only events containing (comma separated, blank = every event)

data_description.name: Also the new calendar's name, e.g. Trash pickups becomes calendar.homekeeper_trash_pickups.
data_description.match: For a city trash calendar, use garbage: it may also list drop-off and leaf collection days.

by.name: Done by
by.description: Who did it (a person id). Defaults to the person who owns the duty.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note saved in the history.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Hide a duty's reminders until later.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: Skip this occurrence (a reason is required).

signal.name: Signal
signal.description: Tell a signal-driven duty that its event happened.

duty_id.name: Duty
duty_id.description: The id of the duty to open from an outside signal.

owners.name: Owners
owners.description: Person ids; the first is the primary owner.

import_pack.name: Import pack
import_pack.description: Import duties from a YAML pack.

path.name: File path
path.description: Path to a pack file inside your Home Assistant config folder.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Check the pack and report what would change, without changing anything.

export_pack.name: Export pack
export_pack.description: Export a module as a YAML pack.
